column1: # PostgreSQL 18.4 regression tests (parallel_schedule): scope for the SQL-parity campaign.
# Columns: test <TAB> in|out <TAB> reason (required for "out"; optional note for "in").
# Rule: SQL language behaviour is in scope; tools, monitoring, replication, maintenance internals,
# physical storage and C-extension loading are out. When in doubt: in.
# Tests not listed here default to "in".
